verdict.rationale: Vercel documents Fluid compute for on-demand server-side code that scales concurrency, and a single function instance can handle multiple connections, so automatic scaling under load is a first-party capability. The evidence gives no boot-time figure and no concrete scale ceiling. missing for 10: documented sub-second instance boot/cold-start times, evidence of scaling to tens of thousands of instances, independent or hands-on corroboration of scaling behavior.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can deploy instances that boot in under a second and scale to tens of thousands under load

citations.quote: Run server-side code on demand with Fluid compute, which scales concurrency for AI and I/O-heavy workloads.
Fluid compute allows a single function instance to handle multiple WebSocket connections.
Run production workloads in isolated containers on Vercel.
